mcqs.question: Whom does the USPSTF recommend for annual LDCT lung-cancer screening?

options.A: Adults 50 to 80 years with 20 pack-years who smoke or quit within 15 years
options.C: Never-smokers with a family history only
options.E: Only people who quit more than 20 years ago

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Adults 50 to 80 years with 20 pack-years who smoke or quit within 15 years
mcqs.explanation: Annual LDCT is recommended for adults aged 50 to 80 with a 20 pack-year history who smoke or quit within the past 15 years.

sourceRefs.excerpt: The USPSTF recommends annual screening for lung cancer with low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) in adults aged 50 to 80 years who have a 20 pack-year smoking history and currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years.

mcqs.question: When does the USPSTF say screening should stop?

options.A: After 15 years without smoking, or when a health problem substantially limits life expectancy or curative lung surgery
options.E: Only if the person asks to continue

mcqs.correctAnswerText: After 15 years without smoking, or when a health problem substantially limits life expectancy or curative lung surgery
mcqs.explanation: Stop once the person has not smoked for 15 years or develops a health problem that substantially limits life expectancy or curative surgery.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Screening should be discontinued once a person has not smoked for 15 years or develops a health problem that substantially limits life expectancy or the ability or willingness to have curative lung surgery.

mcqs.question: Which test does the USPSTF name for this screening?

options.B: Chest radiography as the preferred screen

mcqs.explanation: The recommendation is annual screening with low-dose CT.

mcqs.question: What smoking exposure does the recommendation require?
mcqs.explanation: Eligibility includes a 20 pack-year smoking history.

mcqs.question: A former smoker is included if they quit within how long?
mcqs.explanation: The recommendation includes people who currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years.
